header.description: Stats, vitals, creation points and movement (FAM-02): HP/mana/MR/picklocks/stealth, regen rates, encumbrance and movement, CP costs, and the Races/Classes row lookups. Stock path only (bGreaterMUD false).
notes: Cases that read a Races or Classes row carry it as an extra 'race'/'class' input (the row the lookup lands on, or null), written from the stock database, because the Rust port never reads SQLite.
ComputeAvgLevelMaxStats walks every race; the case carries all of them in 'races'.
CP_CostForRaise, LevelNeededForCP and the Races/Classes getters are called directly; their Private/Public status does not matter to the oracle.
